review_candidates.title: IT Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The environment values integrity, public service, and continuous improvement in administrative and digital capabilities. Responsibilities include supervising an IT team, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and service requests. The IT Manager plans and implements IT projects, coordinates upgrades, maintains cybersecurity controls, and ensures data protection and compliance with relevant policies and standards. Qualifications Demonstrated ab
eligibility_evidence: Company Description The Egyptian Cabinet serves as the executive branch of the Government of Egypt, overseeing the implementation of national policies, programs, and strategic initiatives.
Professionals joining the organization contribute to high-impact projects that affect citizens and institutions across the country.
Role Description The IT Manager is a full-time, hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with a combination of onsite work at Cabinet facilities and some work-from-home flexibility.
Proficiency with systems administration, enterprise software, cloud or hybrid environments, and troubleshooting hardware and software issues.
